mean2

mean2.Rmd


library(saferTool)


Datasets 

vec1 <- -1:3 # vector of integers
vec2 <- c(1:3, NA) # vector of integers with NA
vec3 <- c(1:3, Inf) # vector of integers with Inf
vec4 <- 1:3 / 3 # vector of proportions
vec5 <- c(1, 2, NA, -Inf) # vector of integers but stored as "double", with NA and Inf
vec6 <- c(1, 2, 3, 4, 100) # vector of integers with an outlier
log1 <- c(TRUE, FALSE, NA) # logical vector with NA
log2 <- c(TRUE, FALSE, FALSE) # logical vector                    
mat1 <- matrix(vec1) # 1D matrix of integers
mat2 <- matrix(vec5) # 1D matrix of integers, NA and Inf
mat3 <- matrix(log1) # 1D matrix of logical values
mat4 <- matrix(log2) # 1D matrix of logical values and NA
fac1 <- factor(vec5) # 1D factor
tab1 <- table(fac1) # 1D table

Simple examples 

mean2(x = vec1) # vector of integers
>  [1] 1
mean2(x = vec2) # vector of integers with NA
>  [1] NA
mean2(x = vec3) # vector of integers with Inf
>  [1] Inf
mean2(x = vec4) # vector of proportions
>  [1] 0.6666667
mean2(x = vec5) # vector of integers but stored as "double", with NA and Inf
>  [1] NA
mean2(x = log1) # logical vector with NA
>  [1] NA
mean2(x = log2) # logical vector
>  [1] 0.3333333
mean2(x = mat1) # 1D matrix of integers
>  [1] 1
mean2(x = mat2) # 1D matrix of integers, NA and Inf
>  [1] NA
mean2(x = mat3) # 1D matrix of logical values
>  [1] NA
mean2(x = mat4) # 1D matrix of logical values and NA
>  [1] 0.3333333
mean2(x = tab1) # 1D table
>  [1] 1


Argument trim 

mean2(
    x = vec6, 
    trim = 0.2
)
>  [1] 3

mean2(
    x = vec6, 
    trim = 0.5
)
>  [1] 3


Argument na_rm 

mean2(
    x = vec1, 
    na_rm = TRUE
)
>  [1] 1

mean2(
    x = vec2, 
    na_rm = TRUE
)
>  [1] 2

mean2(
    x = log2, 
    na_rm = TRUE
)
>  [1] 0.3333333

mean2(
    x = log1, 
    na_rm = TRUE
)
>  [1] 0.5

mean2(
    x = mat3, 
    na_rm = TRUE
)
>  [1] 0.5


Argument finite 

mean2(
    x = vec1,
    finite = TRUE
)
>  [1] 1

mean2(
    x = vec3,
    finite = TRUE
)
>  [1] 2


Argument safer_check 

mean2(
    x = vec1,
    safer_check = TRUE
)
>  [1] 1

mean2(
    x = tab1,
    safer_check = TRUE
)
>  [1] 1


All the arguments 

mean2(
    x = vec5,
    trim = 0.2,
    na_rm = TRUE,
    finite = FALSE,
    safer_check = TRUE
)
>  [1] -Inf

mean2(
    x = mat4,
    trim = 0,
    na_rm = TRUE,
    finite = FALSE,
    safer_check = TRUE
)
>  [1] 0.3333333
